milestone: SeLinOS Linux syscall ABI M11 getdents64 fail-closed rejection

contract.accepted_request: Only getdents64(fd=6, non-zero mapped-probe address, count=32) in the fixed test sequence is accepted.
contract.result: The request returns -ENOTDIR (negative 20) with no user-buffer access and no VFS IPC.
contract.negative_scope: M11 creates no directory FD, cursor, linux_dirent64 payload, pathname traversal, directory metadata, CPIO directory interpretation or POSIX directory semantics.

required_markers: SeLinOS ABI M11: getdents64(FD 6) rejected with ENOTDIR; no directory service.
SeLinOS ABI M10: FD 6 probe-local two-word fstat record mediated; not Linux struct stat.
forbidden_markers: SeLinOS ABI gateway: bounded getdents64 rejected request shape.

not_claimed: directory FD, cursor, linux_dirent64 data or readdir compatibility
directory traversal, path resolution, metadata or CPIO directory support
arbitrary descriptors, general VFS, persistent filesystem, package state database
dpkg, apt, Linux package installation or package repository access
